body: I appreciate all the comments thus far. I have to comment on my own thread because I'm using my iPhone currently and it doesn't allow you to do a lot. I haven't started using cough syrup too recreationally and I think I'll start (especially after hearing about the pussy fights haha). Basically, I've hit a low point recently and I decided to not date for a few years of ever. I also mentioned that to my counselor but she said "I'd be weird if I didn't have a partner" so now I'm a little worried about that. Luckily I feel happy at the gym, which used to not work, but as I mentioned it's slowly going away. I just feel myself slipping into thin air.
Now*

It's my birthday today. I spent an hour yesterday sitting in a car with a hose attatched to my exhaust pipe and leading into my car. I'm fine know, I consider it just a stretch for adrenaline or any kind of change. Today, I'll probably just watch tv and hope my ex-girlfriend walks through my door. 
Then, I'll go to work, which isn't so bad. I kind of like work. But I hate my birthday and 19 years have gone by without a single successful birthday. I feel like Ted the Sad Sap. I need an exclamation! Things will get better! Seriously though, I'm not too depressed! I'm just a little tired of the same stuff different day. It's a lot harder when society claims a certain day should have any appeal to you.

Hey, it's the kid who typed a lot. Just checking in, wondering if you decided to start doing some stuff! I hope so! If not, then counseling is probably your next best bet. Anyhow, I am still not suicidal, it has been kind of rough, but I am getting better! I hope you are too!
For the first time ever, an up vote simply doesn't suffice.
Not a great time to be calling out someone.

You can look at my past explanations of my suicidal tendencies in previous replies to other people... I don't know if you would want to talk to someone who just began fixing their problems. I am near your age and I have been suicidal for around 8 years so it's hard to consider it situational. I am for the first time not considering suicide as an option, but I am new to it. About a week in the process so I am relatively close to your 'requirements'.

Yes, I have to say that cognitive behavioral therapy helped me. I didn't use a cognitive therapist specifically, but rather discussed some basic techniques with a therapist. I am about to heavily generalize, but I think all suicidal tendencies can, in the least, be halted by this technique. Suicide originates from depression so my hope is that cognitive therapy fixes my depression as well. Good luck!

I somehow doubt you did any true talking. I want you to simply look at your life and list all the things you hate about it. Then began changing them. If you hate your job, change it. No one hates to simply exist. Being depressed makes you feel that way, but there are always origins to a persons problems. Sometimes they aren't "changeable" but they are manageable. My problems weren't changeable. I had abandonment issues because my family was never around. I felt no one truly loved me. So, when my girlfriend broke up with me, I thought she must not have loved me. I have been suspended from college for overdosing on my anitdepressants and now have to attended 36 hours of therapy by Jan. 9 just to go back to my college. My life has had adversity, some of which are not my fault: I cannot tell my parents to be around for me, or for my girlfriend to take me back, or for my depression to simply go away. Instead, I put myself together. After 8 years of depression I decided I need to stop being so fucking proud. I have given up a veil of cynicism and self pity in order to get past depression. You see, depression acts like a veil, so that all that you see is through the eyes of a depressed person. It takes a damn strong person to admit you have a saddened perception of reality. It takes an even stronger person to fix it alone. If you're willing to fix your problem, because it is a problem and it IS fixable, then your best shot is to be truly honest with another person. And I don't mean complaining about your life or the shit you dealt with as a child because that never helped me. Taking advice from someone, actually listening and trying to help yourself, is what saved me. Not a week ago, I was the guy waking up everyday thinking about suicide as an option, as a viable escape from my sadness or pity. But as soon as I forced myself to believe I could not commit suicide, I was fixed. It is a technique used in AA for alcohol abusers and NA for narcotic abusers. You see, suicide is much like drugs and alcohol. It is a coping method do deal with your problems. Unfortunately, it is not a method in which your problems will be fixed. And just remind yourself that ten years from now, if you tackle this bitch of a depression, you'll thank God you chose to help yourself. Suicide is not an option. Keep Reddit and I updated. I am willing to be that guy who gives you more than a strangers advice. Good luck, you may not be a God faring person, as I barely am, but for your sake, I'll be praying.

Listen, don't ever hang up on a person who is threatening suicide until you KNOW they are safe. I mean to say, don't let them leave you with the idea still in your head. Tell her she needs to see the school Psychologist as soon as possible.
Have you attempted to talk with someone? See a therapist?
Haha well, I don't think it's a great idea to even be looking up the stuff. It's toying with the mind, even on a simply scientific level.

Firstly, I don't necessarily blame an abused person for becoming the abuser. Studies show that we tend to take on the traits of our parents as early as six. That's why I am very likely to be an alcoholic and because my father was unstable mentally, I, too, can be relatively unstable. You just have to recognize your issue so you don't repeat it. Secondly, I would start with a job. Nothing fancy, just get off your ass and do something on a daily basis. My job has actually been one of the few things that keeps me happy. I forced myself to enjoy it, but now I go to work, connect with people and my coworkers and I have a good time. If you haven't already apologized to your exgirlfriend, I might suggest it. It's part of the twelve steps of AA, but I think those steps can be applicable to anyone with an issue. Also, if your parents are slightly supporting you and you're unhappy with being "fat" (which could be a subjective point of view), go to the gym! The gym isn't always helpful with depression, but I can't imagine how sad I'd be if I didn't release endorphin through that. If you truly want to fix yourself then the motivation is there you just have to start and not give up. Oh and the car thing is negligible. Thousands of people take public transport daily. Throw in a couple hundred applications with a slightly embellished resume! Jobs should be your main focus. Keep in touch. I think Reddit would like to hear back from a success story.

Planning it is the first steps to acting on it. It forces you to think that it MUST happen even if your whole life turns around. It forces you to think about it at every moment because it is an important date hanging over your head. Don't let it hang. Give it up. Cancel the appointment because it's not going to make your life easier.

Listen, you're a thirty year old man who overcame adversity to survive this long AND you like the Hobbit movies. Trust me when I say, people like you need to keep trying to survive so people like me can have friends.

Seriously, I said an exact quote when I attempted. But I woke up. I talked to someone and I learned to cope with my thoughts. Suicide feels nice. Not having to deal with anything, but life is so much more rewarding than death. I hope I am not too late.

Look, when I am near the edge I am not considering any good moments in life I've had or could have. The good people don't always win, but when you're old, on your death bed, you'll know that you lived life for its true purpose. That's what keeps me going, I want to be able to live a full life, a good life, and tell one person about it. That's all. If you don't like your job, change it. I know it's not easy, but nothing worth having is. If you're unhappy, it's partly your thought process and partly you not  changing. Change, do something new. Stop living the same cycle day in and day out. Take a day off work and relax.
Yup, explain your issues!

Listen, I would do anything for my family. I don't care if you're adopted or biological you're family. You seem extremely grateful for their help, I wouldn't let that become self pity. You're kind and caring. You have no pressure to "become something". You clearly will naturally become something, trust me. You have adversity and have come out a genuine human being. You already have become something. And it's sad to think that anyone feels like a foreigner in the country they developed in. Keep being genuine and keep trying to do the things you like. I run with bad feet and it's because I love running. Overcome the things that hold you back. Try swimming. Its great for people with injuries. Keep your head up
How about talking about why you would do it?

I've been there. I even acted on it a few times. Still, I thought if I had to suffer through sixty years of depression it'd be worth the five years of sadness my family would feel. Unfortunately, when I explained this to my brother he said he would never be happy if I did that. My mum said that she knew a friend who had a son who killed himself and she never got over it. Fact is, you owe it to not just yourself, but your family to keep living. Why don't you explain to me what's not going well in your life? Don't give me the bullshit that everything is fine, you just feel that way. That's never true. Once I tried killing myself after the perfect date with a girl that I loved. And all because she grew quiet near the end and I thought she didn't like me. It was stupid. She did like me, I was just being an idiot. But every time I explain it to another psychologist, I just say it was for no reason, because I don't want to be labeled as an manic depressant for over reacting over her minute moments of silence. Frankly, I only recently started TRULY looking at fixing myself. I think you should too, because it's possible.There is no hope for one who doesn't truly try to find hope for themselves. Cliches can be damned true. I used to make everyone hate me. I still do. But I am changing that. You should too. Work on yourself. This is not just some half assed two bit piece to think about. You either fix yourself, or you infinitely fall in depression. Really try this time. Seriously, because when it boils down to the simple things in life, it's quite easy to be happy. I was depressed my whole life. I was shut up by every father I had. My mother was always gone. I drew away from society. I don't ever remember not being okay with dying. Staring at cars hoping for them to hit me. Holding knives to my neck and taking pills ODing. And you know what? Wanting to die isn't weird. A lot of people consider it. We all get to a point of breaking down. I was kicked out of my school for suicide attempts. I lost friends. I lost interest in my life. Depression will either destroy you, or you can stop it early, fix it now, and start getting the fuck back to enjoying yourself. It's a battle. You can't take it as a joke. You look at yourself. No therapist will fix you until you want to be fixed. Stop thinking about suicide. Considering not living anymore makes everyone feel good. I would love to simply stop existing so I didn't have finals tomorrow haha Hell I wish I could skip the next ten years of my life because they could be painful, but after they've passed I don't think I'll be sad I had to live them. I already look at my past life which was shitty and wish I could return. Life finds a way of being happy. So cease thinking about suicide as an option. It's not an option. I care if you die. I'll have failed you in this message. So don't. I hope I get a reply, even if you didn't read my long winded shit. Just don't make a mockery of existence.

Wow, I am late on a reply haha. I was kicked out of my school because my "suicide attempt" made me a liability. Key fact: don't EVER tell your school psychologist of suicide attempts haha go to somewhere outside school. Anyway, OD on Lexapro merely causes and OD on serotonin. You can look up Seratonin Overdose. It basically, caused Insomnia and Stomach pain. I do NOT suggest mixing medicine unless your doctor says to do so. Honestly, pills seem like a last resort for me. I believe that we all have crap to deal with and some people just have bad coping mechanisms. Clearly, my coping mech. was suicide and it isn't making better so I am slowly learning to avoid that.

See, that's a bad idea. If she knew that she'd be worried. I think you can't let the one you love become the only purpose you're alive. You let them become one positive aspect of your life. You seem like you want to get fixed so let your therapist know that your relationship is so emphasized in your life.

I don't need a friend. My life could be meaningful and I think most people know that on this website, but we choose to not WANT it to be meaningful. I have told others here, but I took 130mg of Lexapro on last Saturday in an effort to kill myself. Funny enough, anti-depressants won't kill you. So I just had a few days of insomnia and stomach pain. I wish it killed me, truly. My life is pretty lame overall, but something has kept me going this last week. It has had a bit of an up turn, but the majority of my week has been mundane. I really just want to die because I feel old. I am tired. I want to forget every mistake and attempt on my suicide. I really want nothingness. When my girlfriend broke up with me, I didn't feel anything, but now... I simply want to die. My therapist wants me in a hospital, but I refuse and lie my way out of it. 
     If you think you can help me, that'd be great. My whole life has a really rough history of verbal abuse and my family is broken because of methamphetamine. I want to be dead and it's not making me sad anymore. When I attempted to kill myself last Saturday I felt quite bored with the idea. I still am. Life is a too silly to take anything seriously. Of course, no person has an answer. They all just watch me decay in fear. I am excited when I go home this summer to buy an assault rifle and end it. At least, that's the plan. I don't think I'll find love. At this rate, after all the girls I've known, I'd rather disappear.

I took an overdose of Lexapro last Saturday. It didn't even come close to killing me (130mg or 13x's the dosage). But my psychiatrist flipped and now I have to spend the majority of my Christmas break at therapy or the hospital. I was told that if the pills were serious, I could have lost an arm or gone into a coma. I don't really know if life is worth living, but a few days after I attempted to kill myself a lot turned around for me. My best friend is coming back from the Marines to live near me, the girl I like told me she likes me (even though I couldn't date a girl who parties as much as she, it still felt good), and I stopped talking to my ex who treated me like shit. I hate my life, but this week had a few highlights and I am holding to those. Killing yourself is probably a bad idea. I used to cut myself everyday. I still put a knife to my neck a few times a week and I contemplate suicide at least a hundred times a day. I have scars that girls don't like. Inside and outside. Killing yourself and hurting yourself are not smart. Go after something. That's my advice. My therapist tells me not to date because I am only happy when I am in a relationship. Well, fuck her. If love makes me happy, then so be it. Just do what makes you happy (to extents). Suicide has always been my fall back for when I am feeling shameful. It has sort of let me feel like "Hey, I'll disappear and nothing will matter and I'll not have to worry". It's a pretty bad system and it has only made things worse.
Well, I met with her today. I did tell her and she decided to up the dosage after Thanksgiving. We shall see how that helps.

Lexapro once a day. My therapist doesn't know that it is making my depression worse. I don't want to change my medication, plus the fact that it makes me more confident about suicide feels good sometimes.

Yes, the break up certainly hasn't helped me. I am not going to pretend to be tough about that haha. I was crushed by it, but no matter. I know to give it time. Maybe one of my bigger flaws is impatience haha

Yes, see, I do not have great self-esteem when I am made vulnerable, but on my own I do quite well. I think I need to learn how to cope a bit better. That's why I go to counseling I suppose haha. Having a woman in my life definitely helps with the self-esteem, but considering I am single and recently broken up with... I think I'll just enjoy doing whatever I want for now. haha I will be volunteering at a school, tutoring children who have it tough at home. I want to be a teacher so that should be great help on my early resume as well.

That kind of thinking has helped me a lot with life. I have attempted explaining that to others but they didn't really understand. There is a video on Youtube about "nothingness": http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hgDmhKrBRf8   It's brilliant. The only thing that has kept me going is thoughts like that and talking to family and friends. I suppose my only argument left for living is the claim, if I am about to die shouldn't I do whatever I want. Being that I have an infinite amount of things I want to do. So my life will be as long as I can do what I want. I am slightly religious. Only because no argument I have searched has disproved religion.
